data.name: Assembly_Info_001
data.value: I'm s-sure you've wanted to have other Pokémon besides the two of you on adventures,[pause=10] right?

data.name: Assembly_Info_002
data.value: With my assembly,[pause=10] you can add or remove anyone you have recruited with Apricorns to your team for adventures!

data.name: Assembly_Info_003
data.value: Any team members you choose for an adventure will wait at the café for you!

data.name: Assembly_Info_004
data.value: Of course,[pause=10] you two will always be on the active team.[pause=0] You wouldn't want to miss out on any adventures,[pause=10] r-right?

data.name: Assembly_Info_005
data.value: Just know that sometimes only the two of you will be allowed on an adventure!

data.name: Assembly_Info_006
data.value: By the way,[pause=10] Pokémon names colored like [color=#00FF00]this[color] instead of [color=#00FFFF]this[color] are species you've already recruited!

data.name: Assembly_Info_007
data.value: Y-you can also view the list of Pokémon you can recruit on a dungeon floor!

data.name: Assembly_Info_008
data.value: Check Recruitment Search in the Others menu.[pause=0] If a species is [color=#FFFF00]yellow[color],[pause=10] that means they're already recruited!

data.name: Assembly_Info_009
data.value: Oh,[pause=10] one more thing![pause=0] You can also ring the signpost by the café to call me to use the assembly!

data.name: Assembly_Info_010
data.value: My e-ears are really sensitive,[pause=10] so I'll hear the bell and come running!

data.name: G2F1_001
data.value: Haha,[pause=10] I was stunned when I stepped inside the guild for the first time too!

data.name: G2F1_002
data.value: It's surprising to see so many Pokémon inside this tree,[pause=10] right?

data.name: G2F1_003
data.value: Greetings.[pause=0] As you may already know,[pause=10] my name is {0}.

data.name: G2F1_004
data.value: {0} informed me that two Pokémon were coming in who required me.[pause=0] That would be you two,[pause=10] correct?

data.name: G2F1_005
data.value: Y-yes![pause=0] That would be us!

data.name: G2F1_006
data.value: I see.[pause=0] What business do you have with the guild today?

data.name: G2F1_007
data.value: The t-two of us are here to...

data.name: G2F1_008
data.value: T-to...

data.name: G2F1_009
data.value: Um...

data.name: G2F1_010
data.value: (O-oh man,[pause=10] I'm t-too nervous to say anything...)

data.name: G2F1_011
data.value: Oh?[pause=0] You wish to apprentice here at the guild?

data.name: G2F1_012
data.value: Y-yes![pause=0] T-that's right!

data.name: G2F1_013
data.value: Oh,[pause=10] I believe I recall now.

data.name: G2F1_014
data.value: You have been here before,[pause=10] have you not?[pause=0] {0} was it?

data.name: G2F1_015
data.value: Y-yes sir...

data.name: G2F1_016
data.value: Ahh,[pause=10] I remember now.[pause=0] You applied here before,[pause=10] but you didn't have a partner.

data.name: G2F1_017
data.value: Looks like you have managed to find one though,[pause=10] hmm?

data.name: G2F1_018
data.value: What would your name be?

data.name: G2F1_019
data.value: Ah...[pause=0] So {0} is your name...

data.name: G2F1_020
data.value: A pleasure to make your acquaintance,[pause=10] {0}.

data.name: G2F1_021
data.value: On to business...[pause=0] As it so happens,[pause=10] we have one opening for a team to apprentice at the guild.

data.name: G2F1_022
data.value: R-really!?

data.name: G2F1_023
data.value: Indeed.[pause=0] However,[pause=10] it is not up to me to decide.

data.name: G2F1_024
data.value: You would have to speak with the Guildmaster.[pause=0] He is the one who decides who may study here.

data.name: G2F1_025
data.value: Please let us speak with the Guildmaster then![pause=0] Please please please!

data.name: G2F1_026
data.value: Hmm...

data.name: G2F1_027
data.value: Very well.[pause=0] I will take you to see the Guildmaster.

data.name: G2F1_028
data.value: Y-you will!?

data.name: G2F1_029
data.value: Yes.[pause=0] Now,[pause=10] please follow behind me to the Guildmaster's office.

data.name: G2F1_030
data.value: I know you might want to look around town...

data.name: G2F1_031
data.value: But since we just joined,[pause=10] I don't think we should leave the tree tonight.

data.name: G2F1_032
data.value: Plus it's getting late...[pause=0] We should go to bed now actually.

data.name: G2F1_033
data.value: But we can look around a bit more if you want!

data.name: G2F1_034
data.value: Let's go look around the guild some more.[pause=0] I think there's more guildmates for us to meet!

data.name: G2F1_035
data.value: How is Team [color=#FFA5FF]Starlight[color] ever going to make a name for itself if you don't pick up the slack!

data.name: G2F1_036
data.value: Some teams,[pause=10] like ours,[pause=10] come here to find jobs posted on the boards.

data.name: G2F1_037
data.value: It's getting late and I wanna eeeeeaaatttt![pause=0] I'm starving!

data.name: G2F1_038
data.value: Yeah![pause=0] We're Team {0}![pause=0] We just joined the guild today!

data.name: G2F1_039
data.value: Hmm,[pause=10] OK.[pause=0] I was worried there was a local team I hadn't documented in my almanac.

data.name: G2F1_040
data.value: I didn't recognize your faces,[pause=10] so I thought maybe I missed a team.

data.name: G2F1_041
data.value: Wait,[pause=10] did you just say you signed up with the guild?

data.name: G2F1_042
data.value: That's right!

data.name: G2F1_043
data.value: Then that means we're guildmates![pause=0] I'm {0}![pause=0] I was the newest member at the guild before you two came along.

data.name: G2F1_044
data.value: This is great![pause=0] I finally have juniors that I can teach!

data.name: G2F1_045
data.value: I'll have to show you both my almanac,[pause=10] I bet you could learn a lot from it!

data.name: G2F1_046
data.value: Almanac?

data.name: G2F1_047
data.value: Yeah![pause=0] Everything I learn about adventuring I write down in my almanac![script=0]

data.name: G2F1_048
data.value: Adventuring teams,[pause=10] expedition discoveries,[pause=10] and dungeoneering techniques and knowledge!

data.name: G2F1_049
data.value: It's all in my almanac so that myself and others can all learn everything there is to know about adventuring!

data.name: G2F1_050
data.value: Wow,[pause=10] that's amazing!

data.name: G2F1_051
data.value: I bet me and {0} could learn a lot of useful stuff from something like that!

data.name: G2F1_052
data.value: When do you think we could look at your almanac?

data.name: G2F1_053
data.value: Anytime you want![pause=0] I'm always happy to share everything I've documented!

data.name: G2F1_054
data.value: But just so you know,[pause=10] there's actually a few books I write stuff in.

data.name: G2F1_055
data.value: It helps me keep the information more organized.[pause=0] Each book is for a different topic!

data.name: G2F1_056
data.value: Since I'm still kinda new,[pause=10] there isn't too much in them yet...

data.name: G2F1_057
data.value: But I add to them as I learn![pause=0] So I'm sure soon enough there'll be more pages than you can count!

data.name: G2F1_058
data.value: Anyway,[pause=10] I keep them in my room.[pause=0] Feel free to read through them anytime...[pause=0] Err...

data.name: G2F1_059
data.value: Hmm.[pause=0] I,[pause=10] um,[pause=10] never got your names.

data.name: G2F1_060
data.value: My name's {0},[pause=10] and my partner over there is {1}.

data.name: G2F1_061
data.value: {0} and {1}.[pause=0] OK,[pause=10] I'll have to make a note of that!

data.name: G2F1_062
data.value: I'm looking forward to learning and training at the guild here with you,[pause=10] Team {0}!

data.name: G2F1_063
data.value: We're all gonna learn how to be great adventurers![pause=0] I just know it!

data.name: G2F1_064
data.value: Hey {0}...[pause=0] It's getting pretty late...

data.name: G2F1_065
data.value: We should head back to our room and hit the hay for the night.

data.name: G2F1_066
data.value: Let's head there whenever you're ready,[pause=10] {0}.

data.name: G2F1_067
data.value: We're all gonna learn how to be great adventurers![pause=0] I just know it!

data.name: G2F1_068
data.value: What do you want?[pause=0] Can't you see I'm doing something here?

data.name: G2F1_069
data.value: Wait,[pause=10] YOU guys were allowed into the guild?[pause=0] What a laugh!

data.name: G2F1_070
data.value: The Guildmaster's just letting anyone in,[pause=10] isn't he?

data.name: G2F1_071
data.value: Huh?

data.name: G2F1_072
data.value: I mean,[pause=10] look at you![pause=0] Total rookies![pause=0] Have you even done any adventuring?

data.name: G2F1_073
data.value: A little?[pause=0] Ha![pause=0] I knew it![pause=0] I could just tell that you're complete and total rookies!

data.name: G2F1_074
data.value: And that look on your face![pause=0] You're all flustered![pause=0] Hahaha!

data.name: G2F1_075
data.value: What's your deal?[pause=0] We just wanted to say hello to you!

data.name: G2F1_076
data.value: My DEAL is that I have no respect for a bunch of greenhorns like you!

data.name: G2F1_077
data.value: Especially when they waltz in here and bother me while I'm scouting outlaws![pause=0] It's unbelievable!

data.name: G2F1_078
data.value: Are you for real?[pause=0] What's unbelievable is how big a jerk you are!

data.name: G2F1_079
data.value: Is something the ma-a-a-atter, {0}?

data.name: G2F1_080
data.value: Wh-what?[pause=0] Uh,[pause=10] n-nope![pause=0] I was just having a conversation with the guild's newest recruits!

data.name: G2F1_081
data.value: Oooh![pause=0] There's new recruits!?[pause=0] Where are they?

data.name: G2F1_082
data.value: Err...

data.name: G2F1_083
data.value: They're right there...

data.name: G2F1_084
data.value: You're the new recruits?[pause=0] Hi hi hi![pause=0] It's grea-a-a-at to meet you![pause=0] My name's {0}!

data.name: G2F1_085
data.value: And this sweetie is {0}!

data.name: G2F1_086
data.value: What are your names?[pause=0] Ooooooh,[pause=10] I bet you have a cool team name!

data.name: G2F1_087
data.value: Um...[pause=0] My name is {0},[pause=10] and my partner there is {1}.[pause=0] We're Team {2}...

data.name: G2F1_088
data.value: Grea-a-a-at to meet the both of you![pause=0] And I love your team name!

data.name: G2F1_089
data.value: {0}![pause=0] Rolls right off the tongue!

data.name: G2F1_090
data.value: Oh,[pause=10] thank you![pause=0] I'm happy to meet you too!

data.name: G2F1_091
data.value: {0}?[pause=0] Aren't you going to say something to our new friends?

data.name: G2F1_092
data.value: O-of course!

data.name: G2F1_094
data.value: ...nice to meet the both of you.

data.name: G2F1_095
data.value: ...[pause=0]Likewise...

data.name: G2F1_096
data.value: Huh?[pause=0] Is something wrong?

data.name: G2F1_097
data.value: {0} wasn't being a mea-a-a-anie again,[pause=10] was he?

data.name: G2F1_098
data.value: Oh,[pause=10] uh,[pause=10] no![pause=0] Everything's fine!

data.name: G2F1_099
data.value: Oh,[pause=10] good![pause=0] I was afraid he was being a big\nmea-a-a-anie again!

data.name: G2F1_100
data.value: He can get really grumpy whenever we have trouble bringing in an outlaw.[pause=0] Today's was a slippery one!

data.name: G2F1_101
data.value: Isn't that right,[pause=10] {0}?

data.name: G2F1_103
data.value: Well,[pause=10] don't mind him.[pause=0] He gets really bashful sometimes.

data.name: G2F1_104
data.value: Anywa-a-a-ay...[pause=0] You're gonna have a lot of fun working with the guild!

data.name: G2F1_105
data.value: We're gonna do all sorts of fun stuff together now that you've joined!

data.name: G2F1_106
data.value: Me and {0} can even show you some ways to take down bad guys sometime![pause=0] We'll have a bla-a-a-ast!

data.name: G2F1_107
data.value: That sounds great,[pause=10] {0}![pause=0] I can't wait!

data.name: G2F1_108
data.value: Good luck,[pause=10] you two![pause=0] It's back to finding tomorrow's ba-a-a-addie to beat for me now!

data.name: G2F1_109
data.value: Hey {0}...[pause=0] It's getting pretty late...

data.name: G2F1_110
data.value: We should head back to our room and hit the hay for the night.

data.name: G2F1_111
data.value: Let's head there whenever you're ready,[pause=10] {0}.

data.value: (She's too invested in the job board to notice you.)

data.name: G2F2_001
data.value: This is the Job Bulletin Board.[pause=0] Requests from Pokémon from all over are posted here daily.

data.name: G2F2_002
data.value: These requests can include tasks such as rescuing,[pause=10] client escort,[pause=10] and item retrieval.

data.name: G2F2_003
data.value: You should know that almost all Job Bulletin Board tasks take place within mystery dungeons.

data.name: G2F2_004
data.value: In case you are unaware,[pause=10] mystery dungeons are special places that change each time you enter.

data.name: G2F2_005
data.value: The layout,[pause=10] items you find,[pause=10] and opponents you face differ each time you explore.

data.name: G2F2_006
data.value: They truly are wonderous locations to adventure in.[pause=0] But as fantastical as they are,[pause=10] they are also dangerous.

data.name: G2F2_007
data.value: Should either one of you be defeated in a dungeon,[pause=10] you will both be expelled from the dungeon.

data.name: G2F2_008
data.value: Furthermore,[pause=10] you will lose most of the money you are carrying and most items in your Treasure Bag.

data.name: G2F2_009
data.value: Some items,[pause=10] such as the {0} the Guildmaster gave you,[pause=10] are special and cannot be lost.

data.name: G2F2_010
data.value: Items you have equipped also cannot be lost,[pause=10] fortunately.

data.name: G2F2_011
data.value: Be sure to visit the proper facilities in town to safeguard any possessions you cannot bear to lose.

data.name: G2F2_012
data.value: Is that all clear to you?

data.name: G2F2_013
data.value: Well,[pause=10] that is a lot to take in...

data.name: G2F2_014
data.value: But I'm sure we'll manage to remember all of that!

data.name: G2F2_015
data.value: Very good.[pause=0] Now,[pause=10] for your task today,[pause=10] I shall choose a job from the board for you to undertake.

data.name: G2F2_016
data.value: Since you are just beginners,[pause=10] let's select a simple task from the board.

data.name: G2F2_017
data.value: Let's see here...

data.name: G2F2_018
data.value: Excuse me,[pause=10] you work for the guild,[pause=10] right?[pause=0] You're that {0} fellow,[pause=10] aren't you?

data.name: G2F2_019
data.value: Oh,[pause=10] apologies.[pause=0] I did not notice you there at first.

data.name: G2F2_020
data.value: Yes,[pause=10] I am {0}.[pause=0] What business do you have with the guild?

data.name: G2F2_021
data.value: I need help![pause=0] {0},[pause=10] my precious baby boy...[pause=0] He's gone missing!

data.name: G2F2_022
data.value: Your son has gone missing?[pause=0] Are you sure?

data.name: G2F2_023
data.value: Y-yes![pause=0] He was in bed when I went to sleep last night...[br]...But when I woke up this morning he was nowhere to be seen!

data.name: G2F2_024
data.value: I went all over town and asked anyone if they had seen him...[pause=0] Nobody has spotted him since yesterday!

data.name: G2F2_025
data.value: Oh,[pause=10] what if something happened to my baby boy...[pause=0]\nI don't think I'd be able to forgive myself!

data.name: G2F2_026
data.value: I am sure nothing of the sort has happened to him.[pause=0] Perhaps he just wandered off.

data.name: G2F2_027
data.value: If he were to wander off,[pause=10] do you have any idea where he might go?

data.name: G2F2_028
data.value: No...[pause=0] He's never done something like this before!

data.name: G2F2_029
data.value: Oh...[pause=0] Where could he be...?

data.name: G2F2_030
data.value: Huh?[pause=0] Do I think that he may have ran away?

data.name: G2F2_032
data.value: ...It's possible...[pause=0] We had an...[pause=0] argument last evening,[pause=10] and he was very upset.

data.name: G2F2_033
data.value: What was the argument about?

data.name: G2F2_034
data.value: Well...[pause=0] He hadn't done his chores yet,[pause=10] and it was starting to get late.

data.name: G2F2_035
data.value: So I told him to stop playing with his friend and to go gather firewood for the fireplace.

data.name: G2F2_036
data.value: He refused,[pause=10] so I threatened to take away his dinner if he didn't do his chores.

data.name: G2F2_037
data.value: He told me that he wished he was grown up so he wouldn't have to listen to me...

data.name: G2F2_038
data.value: ...Then he ran home and collected some wood outside of our home.

data.name: G2F2_039
data.value: I thought that was the end of it,[pause=10] but...[pause=0]\nI guess he ran off after I fell asleep.

data.name: G2F2_041
data.value: Did you say that he wished to be "grown up"?

data.name: G2F2_042
data.value: Yes... But I don't see how that's important.

data.name: G2F2_043
data.value: If he wanted to grow up...[pause=0] I believe he may have ran off towards Luminous Spring.

data.name: G2F2_044
data.value: Oh![pause=0] You might be right![pause=0] The Luminous Spring is just to the north of town,[pause=10] he could easily have gone there!

data.name: G2F2_045
data.value: Luminous Spring?

data.name: G2F2_046
data.value: Luminous Spring is the source of the Illuminant River,[pause=10] the river that runs through this very town.

data.name: G2F2_047
data.value: It is also the place that Pokémon go to evolve.

data.name: G2F2_048
data.value: If {0} wanted to grow up,[pause=10] evolving is,[pause=10] in a way,[pause=10] one way to do so.

data.name: G2F2_049
data.value: ...Though I doubt he actually meets the requirements to evolve.

data.name: G2F2_050
data.value: The problem now is that...[pause=0] The Luminous Spring is located at the end of {0}...

data.name: G2F2_051
data.value: A mystery dungeon.

data.name: G2F2_052
data.value: You're saying my baby is in a place as dangerous as a mystery dungeon!?

data.name: G2F2_053
data.value: Potentially.[pause=0] We will need to organize a team to go and search for him.

data.name: G2F2_054
data.value: However,[pause=10] I fear that all of our experienced apprentices are already out on their tasks for the day.

data.name: G2F2_055
data.value: Which means that we have nobody available to go on such a search.

data.name: G2F2_056
data.value: We'll do it![pause=0] We can rescue {0}!

data.name: G2F2_057
data.value: You two are too inexperienced for such an undertaking.[pause=0] I would prefer we get a more practiced team.

data.name: G2F2_058
data.value: C'mon![pause=0] We need to find {0} before anything happens to him!

data.name: G2F2_059
data.value: And you said it yourself,[pause=10] nobody else is available right now for the job!

data.name: G2F2_060
data.value: Plus,[pause=10] this {0} is close to town.[pause=0] It can't be that dangerous!

data.name: G2F2_061
data.value: I know {0} and I can do it!

data.name: G2F2_062
data.value: Right,[pause=10] {0}?

data.name: G2F2_063
data.value: See?[pause=0] We can do this![pause=0] Please,[pause=10] just give us this chance and we will rescue {0}!

data.name: G2F2_064
data.value: ...Very well.

data.name: G2F2_065
data.value: Really?

data.name: G2F2_066
data.value: Yes.[pause=0] There are no other options,[pause=10] and on second consideration,[pause=10] this seems like a job that you could handle.

data.name: G2F2_067
data.value: As such,[pause=10] in lieu of taking a mission from the Job Bulletin Board...

data.name: G2F2_068
data.value: ...I will entrust the task of searching {0} for {1} to the two of you.

data.name: G2F2_069
data.value: You two will go looking for my baby?[pause=0] Thank you!

data.name: G2F2_070
data.value: Of course![pause=0] We won't let you down!

data.name: G2F2_071
data.value: You should get started on your search immediately.

data.name: G2F2_072
data.value: As I said earlier,[pause=10] {0} is located to the north of town.

data.name: G2F2_073
data.value: You should prepare yourselves with the proper facilities in town,[pause=10] then head north to search for {0}.

data.name: G2F2_074
data.value: If you manage to find him,[pause=10] please bring him back to town immediately.

data.name: G2F2_075
data.value: Got it![pause=0] We'll get right to it then!

data.name: G2F2_076
data.value: C'mon,[pause=10] {0}![pause=0] Let's get ready to save {1}!

data.name: G2F2_077
data.value: {0}![pause=0] My baby!

data.name: G2F2_078
data.value: You're back,[pause=10] safe and sound![pause=0] I was so scared I was going to lose you!

data.name: G2F2_079
data.value: Oh momma...[pause=0] I was afraid I was gonna be stuck there forever!

data.name: G2F2_080
data.value: I never should have ran away.[pause=0] I'm sorry...

data.name: G2F2_081
data.value: I'm sorry too,[pause=10] sweetie.[pause=0] I know it's been hard now that I need you to do more around the house...

data.name: G2F2_082
data.value: But all that matters now though is that you're safe.[pause=0] Just promise me you'll never do something like this again.

data.name: G2F2_083
data.value: I promise...

data.name: G2F2_084
data.value: I don't think I can ever thank you two enough for returning my baby boy to me.

data.name: G2F2_085
data.value: D-Don't worry about it![pause=0] That's what we're here for!

data.name: G2F2_086
data.value: Don't be so modest![pause=0] Please,[pause=10] take this as thanks for bringing him back home!

data.name: G2F2_087
data.value: Woah![pause=0] You're giving us all this?[pause=0] Are you sure?

data.name: G2F2_088
data.value: As sure as sure can be![pause=0] You saved my baby boy after all![pause=0] He's worth everything to me!

data.name: G2F2_089
data.value: Wow![pause=0] Thank you very much!

data.name: G2F2_090
data.value: Of course![pause=0] And again...[pause=0] Thank you,[pause=10] thank you so much!

data.name: G2F2_091
data.value: Come on sweetie,[pause=10] let's go home and have dinner.

data.name: G2F2_092
data.value: Hooray,[pause=10] dinner![pause=0] I'm starving!

data.name: G2F2_093
data.value: Indeed,[pause=10] you did it.[pause=0] Well done,[pause=10] Team {0}.

data.name: G2F2_094
data.value: You did an excellent job bringing {0} back to his mother.

data.name: G2F2_095
data.value: To think that he was naïve enough to believe he was ready for evolution.

data.name: G2F2_096
data.value: That reminds me...[pause=0] {0}...

data.name: G2F2_097
data.value: Yes?[pause=0] What is it?

data.name: G2F2_098
data.value: The spring...[pause=0] Does it still do anything even if you're not ready for evolution?

data.name: G2F2_099
data.value: Indeed it does.[pause=0] It would let you know that you do not meet the requirements for evolution.

data.name: G2F2_100
data.value: That's strange,[pause=10] because the spring wasn't doing anything at all for any of us.

data.name: G2F2_101
data.value: What do you mean it did not do anything?

data.name: G2F2_102
data.value: Well,[pause=10] {0},[pause=10] {1},[pause=10] and I all tried standing in the light of the spring.

data.name: G2F2_103
data.value: But no matter who tried,[pause=10] nothing happened.[pause=0] We didn't hear a voice or anything.

data.name: G2F2_104
data.value: Is something wrong with the spring?

data.name: G2F2_106
data.value: ...[pause=0]No.[pause=0] It is nothing to be concerned about.[pause=0] The spring has...[pause=30] been known to do this before.

data.name: G2F2_107
data.value: OK.[pause=0] That's good to hear.[pause=0] I was worried for a bit there.

data.name: G2F2_108
data.value: You two should head upstairs.[pause=0] Dinner should be ready any moment.[pause=0] I will be up shortly.

data.name: G2F2_109
data.value: Sounds like {0} can't wait!

data.name: G2F2_110
data.value: C'mon,[pause=10] {0}![pause=0] Let's go get some dinner before your stomach barks at us again!

data.name: G2F2_112
data.value: What about thissss one?

data.name: G2F2_113
data.value: Too weak.

data.name: G2F2_114
data.value: Well,[pause=10] what about thissss one?

data.name: G2F2_115
data.value: Not a real challenge.[pause=0] You scared of fighting a real outlaw or something?

data.name: G2F2_116
data.value: Had to make ssssure to pick one you'd be able to handle.[pause=0] Sssseeing how you're sssso delicate and all...

data.name: G2F2_117
data.value: Tch...[pause=0] Ain't that a convenient excuse...

data.name: G2F2_118
data.value: Yeah yeah.[pause=0] Now sssstop being sssso picky.

data.name: G2F2_119
data.value: Team [color=#FFA5FF]Rivalssss[color] will get a bad rep if you keep ussss here insssstead of in the field catching outlawssss.

data.name: G2F2_121
data.value: {0} is sending you over to Sensei {1} for training,[pause=10] huh?

data.name: G2F2_122
data.value: She's definitely...[pause=0] Um...[pause=0] a character alright...

data.name: G2F2_123
data.value: She's a great teacher,[pause=10] though.[pause=0] Make sure you do your best to learn from her!

data.name: G2F2_124
data.value: I can't fly yet myself,[pause=10] but my partner {0} is a master of flying!

data.name: G2F2_125
data.value: I can't wait to soar the skies like him one day!

data.name: G2F2_126
data.value: We would have flown us here in a jiffy,[pause=10] but,[pause=10] erm...

data.name: G2F2_127
data.value: Our...[pause=0] wings were too tired after flying around all day.[pause=0] So we and {0} had to walk.

data.name: G2F2_128
data.value: I'm almost finished updating the job boards.

data.name: G2F2_129
data.value: Just need that l-last team to leave so I can update that board.

data.name: G2F2_130
data.value: Hopefully they don't take too long...[pause=0] It's almost dinner time,[pause=10] and I'm f-famished!

data.name: G2F2_131
data.value: You should prepare yourselves with the proper facilities in town,[pause=10] then head north to search for {0}.

data.name: G2F2_132
data.value: If you manage to find him,[pause=10] please bring him back to town immediately.

data.name: G2F2_133
data.value: But boss...[pause=0] Aren't higher bountied criminals more dangerous?[pause=0] Are you sure we can handle it?

data.name: G2F2_134
data.value: I can handle anything![pause=0] If you pull your own weight for once,[pause=10] it'll be a cinch!

data.name: G2F2_135
data.value: Y-yes boss...

data.name: G2F3_001
data.value: Escort and outlaw missions are tougher than other types of missions for example.

data.name: G2F3_002
data.value: Harder jobs give more Adventurer Rank Points and usually have better rewards though,[pause=10] so they're worth doing!

data.name: G2F3_003
data.value: We prefer doing rescue missions.[pause=0] They're easier and we still get to help Pokémon in need!

data.name: G2F3_004
data.value: When the outlaw gets found,[pause=10] they spring a trap and an entire group of Pokémon will attack you!

data.name: G2F3_005
data.value: We can personally attest to the power of numbers.[pause=0] You should be prepared for these sorts of outlaws!

data.name: G2F3_006
data.value: If they make it to the stairs,[pause=10] then they'll get away!

data.name: G2F3_007
data.value: It's a good thing {0} can fly.[pause=0] It'll make it much easier to catch up to those outlaws!

data.name: G2F3_008
data.value: You can check the boards whenever you like to see what jobs are available for the taking.

data.name: G2F3_009
data.value: You can hold onto jobs as long as you want,[pause=10] but know that you can only have up to eight jobs at a time!

data.name: G2F3_010
data.value: To check your taken jobs,[pause=10] you can use the boards here or press {0} and choose Job List.

data.name: G2F3_011
data.value: When you take a job from the board,[pause=10] it'll be activated automatically.[pause=0] Only jobs that are activated can be done!

data.name: G2F3_012
data.value: Y-you can suspend an activated job to save for later.[pause=0] Just choose Take Job on it to reactivate it!

data.name: G2F3_013
data.value: A-anyways,[pause=10] as long as a job is activated,[pause=10] you can just go to the mystery dungeon it's in to do it.

data.name: G2F3_014
data.value: You can even activate multiple jobs in the same dungeon and do them all at once if you want!

data.name: G2F3_015
data.value: And that's all there is to it![pause=0] G-good luck with your missions!

data.name: G2F3_016
data.value: I know that name may seem a bit odd,[pause=10] but when we evolve again that name will make perfect sense!

data.name: G2F3_017
data.value: We're hoping to evolve again as soon as we can.[pause=0] Our current forms are...[pause=30] pretty inconvenient,[pause=10] to say the least.

data.name: G2F3_018
data.value: It took us a lot longer than I'd like to admit to make it up the ramp to get here...

data.name: G2F3_019
data.value: That's OK![pause=0] It can be rea-a-a-ally tough sometimes!

data.name: G2F3_020
data.value: I find that whenever I'm struggling to catch an outlaw,[pause=10] using items helps a lot!

data.name: G2F3_021
data.value: The right item can really make all the difference!

data.name: G2F3_022
data.value: Just know that orbs don't work at the end of dungeons,[pause=10] where ba-a-a-addies usually hide!

data.name: G2F3_023
data.value: Oh![pause=0] And if an outla-a-a-aw is using moves on you from far away,[pause=10] move out of their line of sight!

data.name: G2F3_024
data.value: That way they can't use those moves on you anymore![pause=0] They'll have to try something else instead!

data.name: G2F3_025
data.value: I hope that helps![pause=0] Good luck,[pause=10] I know you two\nca-a-a-an do it!

data.name: G2F3_026
data.value: Hahaha![pause=0] I knew you two couldn't do it![pause=0] Hahaha!

data.name: G2F3_027
data.value: Grr...

data.name: G2F3_028
data.value: Talking to {0} is pointless.[pause=0] If we need advice,[pause=10] we should try asking {1}.

data.name: G2F3_029
data.value: 'Ello there.[pause=0] Name's {0},[pause=10] and I'm the head officer 'round these parts.

data.name: G2F3_030
data.value: Thanks to your help,[pause=10] we managed to bag us here a wanted criminal.

data.name: G2F3_031
data.value: For that,[pause=10] my deputies and I thank the two of ya.

data.name: G2F3_032
data.value: I've already given the bounty on this here criminal's head to your superior over there.

data.name: G2F3_033
data.value: Make sure to pick it up from him.[pause=0] Thank ya again for lendin' a hand.

data.name: G2F3_034
data.value: As for you...[pause=0] It's time to go.[pause=0] Come with us,[pause=10] and don't try nothin' funny.

data.name: G2F3_035
data.value: Oh...[pause=0] OK...

data.name: G2F3_036
data.value: Hmm?[pause=0] What's up?

data.name: G2F3_037
data.value: Um...[pause=0] I just wanted to say that I don't think {0} is a bad Pokémon.

data.name: G2F3_038
data.value: I know he's an outlaw and he needs to be arrested and all...

data.name: G2F3_039
data.value: But I think he's just someone who made a poor decision.[pause=0] He isn't wicked or anything.

data.name: G2F3_040
data.value: So,[pause=10] um...[pause=0] Would it be possible for you to go easy on him,[pause=10] please?

data.name: G2F3_042
data.value: ...Sorry mate.[pause=0] Rules 'er rules.

data.name: G2F3_043
data.value: Even if he deserves some leniency,[pause=10] and from what you're sayin',[pause=10] maybe he does...

data.name: G2F3_044
data.value: I have to be consistent or the law wouldn't be fair.

data.name: G2F3_045
data.value: That's just the way it's gotta be.[pause=0] I'm sorry.

data.name: G2F3_047
data.value: ...OK.[pause=0] I understand...

data.name: G2F3_048
data.value: ...Alright.[pause=0] Let's not dawdle here any longer.[pause=0] Get a move on you lot.

data.name: G2F3_049
data.value: ...But it seems to me as though he was a most unusual outlaw.

data.name: G2F3_050
data.value: Regardless,[pause=10] you've captured the outlaw successfully.[pause=0] Congratulations.

data.name: G2F3_051
data.value: Here is the bounty that {0} gave to me.[pause=0] You have earned it.

data.name: G2F3_052
data.value: Now then,[pause=10] I believe {0} should have dinner ready right about now.[pause=0] Will you accompany me upstairs?

data.name: G2F3_053
data.value: ...[pause=0]OK.

data.name: G2F3_054
data.value: Here we are![pause=0] The Outlaw Notice Board!

data.name: G2F3_055
data.value: What's so different about this board compared to the one {0} showed us the other day?

data.name: G2F3_056
data.value: {0} showed you the board on the other side,[pause=10] right?

data.name: G2F3_057
data.value: Tha-a-a-at was the Job Bulletin Board.[pause=0] It has all sorts of regular jobs posted on it!

data.name: G2F3_058
data.value: This is the Outlaw Notice Board.[pause=0] Pokémon on the wrong side of the la-a-a-aw are posted here.

data.name: G2F3_059
data.value: They all have a bounty on their head for one reason or another.[pause=0] They're a real na-a-a-asty bunch!

data.name: G2F3_060
data.value: Outlaws hide out in different mystery dungeons all over the pla-a-a-ace!

data.name: G2F3_061
data.value: It'll be your job to go into those dungeons to bring these ba-a-a-addies to justice!

data.name: G2F3_062
data.value: These outlaws are dangerous,[pause=10] lawless Pokémon,[pause=10] aren't they?[pause=0] Are we really ready to take one on?

data.name: G2F3_063
data.value: No need to worry![pause=0] Just because a Pokémon is an outla-a-a-aw doesn't mean they're that tough!

data.name: G2F3_064
data.value: Outlaws range from criminal masterminds to petty thieves...[pause=0] We'll pick a ba-a-a-addie that's right for you!

data.name: G2F3_065
data.value: Well,[pause=10] I guess that doesn't sound so bad then.

data.name: G2F3_066
data.value: But...[pause=0] What exactly are we supposed to do once we find the outlaw?

data.name: G2F3_067
data.value: Isn't it obvious?[pause=0] You knock 'em out and bring 'em back to town!

data.name: G2F3_068
data.value: Yup![pause=0] Tha-a-a-at's right!

data.name: G2F3_069
data.value: Most outla-a-a-aws won't go peacefully![pause=0] They'll either try to fight you or make a run for it!

data.name: G2F3_070
data.value: If they won't go willingly,[pause=10] you'll need to knock them out!

data.name: G2F3_071
data.value: Once you ma-a-a-anage to bring them back to town,[pause=10] {0} will take care of the rest.

data.name: G2F3_072
data.value: {0}?[pause=0] Who's that?

data.name: G2F3_073
data.value: {0} is the main officer for the region.[pause=0] He handles booking and bounties for outla-a-a-aws!

data.name: G2F3_074
data.value: He'll meet you at the board here if you have any outla-a-a-aws to turn over.

data.name: G2F3_075
data.value: Then,[pause=10] he'll pa-a-a-ay out the bounty and take them away!

data.name: G2F3_076
data.value: And that's the ba-a-a-asics![pause=0] Now,[pause=10] let's pick out an outlaw for you!

data.name: G2F3_077
data.value: {0},[pause=10] can you help me choose a good outla-a-a-aw?

data.name: G2F3_078
data.value: Sure thing,[pause=10] {0}.

data.name: G2F3_079
data.value: I'll be sure to choose one that's weak and pitiful enough for a couple of greenhorns like them to handle.

data.name: G2F3_080
data.value: Grrr...

data.name: G2F3_081
data.value: Tha-a-a-at would be perfect![pause=0] Thank you,[pause=10] {0}!

data.name: G2F3_082
data.value: Alright,[pause=10] let's see here...

data.name: G2F3_083
data.value: Aha!

data.name: G2F3_084
data.value: This one should be weak enough for you newbies.

data.name: G2F3_085
data.value: According to the wanted poster,[pause=10] this {0} goes by {1}.

data.name: G2F3_086
data.value: He's wanted for theft and is hiding out in {0}.

data.name: G2F3_087
data.value: {0}!?[pause=0] Wow!

data.name: G2F3_088
data.value: Looks like {0} picked out a fun one for your first job![pause=0] Hehehe!

data.name: G2F3_089
data.value: What's {0}?

data.name: G2F3_090
data.value: It's a mystery dungeon that ba-a-a-andits turned into a hideout.

data.name: G2F3_091
data.value: The bandits that hide there are relatively weak,[pause=10] so they group together to get a numbers advantage.

data.name: G2F3_092
data.value: Anyone who goes there should be prepared to get ambushed by a whole group of them!

data.name: G2F3_093
data.value: What!?[pause=0] You're saying we're gonna get mugged by bandits if we go after this outlaw!?

data.name: G2F3_094
data.value: Oh,[pause=10] they're all a bunch of pushovers![pause=0] I'm sure you can handle it!

data.name: G2F3_095
data.value: {0} wouldn't have picked it out if he thought you couldn't!

data.name: G2F3_096
data.value: Haha![pause=0] Yup![pause=0] That's true![pause=0] I would never pick a job our newbies couldn't handle!

data.name: G2F3_097
data.value: ...Well...[pause=0] I'm still not sure.[pause=0] It seems so dangerous...

data.name: G2F3_098
data.value: Don't be so worried![pause=0] I know your first outlaw job may seem sca-a-a-ary...

data.name: G2F3_099
data.value: I know {0} and I were sca-a-a-ared on our first job!

data.name: G2F3_100
data.value: Heheheh![pause=0] Is that so?

data.name: G2F3_102
data.value: Yup![pause=0] But even though we were afraid of the\nda-a-a-anger...[pause=0] We caught that outlaw!

data.name: G2F3_103
data.value: I know it's sca-a-a-ary for you too...[pause=0] But I know you two can do it!

data.name: G2F3_104
data.value: Well,[pause=10] if you believe that we can do it,[pause=10] then I'm sure we'll be able to handle it!

data.name: G2F3_105
data.value: We got this,[pause=10] right,[pause=10] {0}?

data.name: G2F3_106
data.value: Yeah![pause=0] You guys got this!

data.name: G2F3_107
data.value: You should head into town now to prepa-a-a-are.

data.name: G2F3_108
data.value: Even if the bandits are weak,[pause=10] you shouldn't underestimate them!

data.name: G2F3_109
data.value: Once you're ready,[pause=10] you should head east out of town towards the dungeon.

data.name: G2F3_110
data.value: The eastern path is the main wa-a-a-ay out of town.

data.name: G2F3_111
data.value: Anytime you want to adventure into a dungeon in the future,[pause=10] be sure to leave town to the east!

data.name: G2F3_112
data.value: Once you've caught this {0} guy,[pause=10] bring him back here for your rewa-a-a-ard!

data.name: G2F3_113
data.value: OK![pause=0] We'll get ready,[pause=10] then head out east!

data.name: G2F3_114
data.value: Thank you for the help,[pause=10] {0}!

data.name: G2F3_115
data.value: A-a-a-anytime![pause=0] Me and {0} are happy to help!

data.name: G2F3_116
data.value: We need to find some jobs for ourselves now,[pause=10] so we'll be here a while.

data.name: G2F3_117
data.value: Come speak to us here if you ha-a-a-ave any trouble![pause=0] Good luck!

data.name: G2F3_118
data.value: Understood![pause=0] Thank you again!

data.name: G2F3_119
data.value: Let's go get ready to take down our first outlaw,[pause=10] {0}!

data.name: G2F3_120
data.value: It is most unusual to see one sticking up for an outlaw they have just apprehended...

data.name: G2F4_001
data.value: I don't know how I'm gonna wait until we leave!

data.name: G2F4_002
data.value: I've gotta release this energy out on some\nba-a-a-addies or I won't sleep tonight!

data.name: G2F4_003
data.value: It must be a really easy exploration if he's letting you rookies tag along![pause=0] Hahaha!

data.name: G2F4_004
data.value: With the expedition coming up now,[pause=10] my culinary expertise will need to be applied elsewhere. {0}

data.name: G2F4_005
data.value: But if that team member was recruited with Apricorns,[pause=10] the rest of the team can still continue on.

data.name: G2F4_006
data.value: The three of us work great as a team,[pause=10] we don't need any more members!

data.name: G2F4_007
data.value: Besides,[pause=10] it'd be hard to find someone that shares our team's unique talents!

data.name: G2F4_008
data.value: They smell nice,[pause=10] especially the blue ones,[pause=10] but they're completely inedible![pause=0] How worthless!

data.name: G2F4_009
data.value: Moves that do damage and cause other effects...[pause=0] How nasty.

data.name: G2F4_010
data.value: Before we evolved,[pause=10] our {0} ability prevented secondary effects from working on us.

data.name: G2F4_011
data.value: But now that we're a {0} and {1},[pause=10] our abilities are completely different.

data.name: G2F4_012
data.value: ...Between that and our current lack of mobility,[pause=10] I'm starting to regret our choice to evolve...

data.name: G2F4_013
data.value: What I bet you don't know is that only certain kinds of moves can critical hit!

data.name: G2F4_014
data.value: Moves like {0} and {1} are able to land critical hits.

data.name: G2F4_015
data.value: Other attacks can land critical hits too if you've used a move like {0}.

data.name: G2F4_016
data.value: Not many adventurers know about this![pause=0] But at least you two know about it now!

data.name: G2F4_017
data.value: Ssssounds intriguing...[pause=0] I would love to join in,[pause=10] but I undersssstand that it issss for guild memberssss only.

data.name: G2F4_018
data.value: Besidessss...[pause=0] The expedition would be too much given I would have to haul {0}'ssss dead weight around.

data.name: G2F4_019
data.value: I would do fine,[pause=10] but {0}?[pause=0] He'd be completely hopeless on an exploration like that.

data.name: G2F4_020
data.value: Hi,[pause=10] {0}![pause=0] What are you up to over here?

data.name: G2F4_021
data.value: W-well,[pause=10] since Apricorns aren't so rare anymore,[pause=10] I've decided to open up the {0} Assembly again!

data.name: G2F4_022
data.value: {0} Assembly?[pause=0] What's that?

data.name: G2F4_023
data.value: It's a place where you can assemble your teammates for adventures!

data.name: G2F4_024
data.value: Assemble my teammates?[pause=0] But...

data.name: G2F4_025
data.value: {0} is right here![pause=0] And we always go on adventures together anyway!

data.name: G2F4_026
data.value: No no![pause=0] I m-meant recruits to your team![pause=0] Surely you've thought about adding more Pokémon to your team,[pause=10] r-right?

data.name: G2F4_027
data.value: Other Pokémon?[pause=0] I hadn't really given it much thought...

data.name: G2F4_028
data.value: But,[pause=10] having other Pokémon with us could be helpful for adventures!

data.name: G2F4_029
data.value: Yeah![pause=0] I think so too![pause=0] The more the m-merrier after all!

data.name: G2F4_030
data.value: Of course,[pause=10] you'll need to recruit other Pokémon first before you can bring them on adventures!

data.name: G2F4_031
data.value: Oh,[pause=10] right![pause=0] How would we do that?

data.name: G2F4_032
data.value: With Apricorns,[pause=10] of course!

data.name: G2F4_033
data.value: If you see a Pokémon you're interested in recruiting while out on an adventure...

data.name: G2F4_034
data.value: ...Throw an Apricorn at them and they may j-join your team!

data.name: G2F4_035
data.value: Woah![pause=0] Is it really that simple?

data.name: G2F4_036
data.value: U-um,[pause=10] well,[pause=10] no...[pause=0] It's a bit more complicated than that...

data.name: G2F4_037
data.value: For example,[pause=10] some Apricorns are better at recruiting certain types of Pokémon!

data.name: G2F4_038
data.value: Also,[pause=10] Pokémon won't join you if they're way stronger than you![pause=0] And some Pokémon won't join no matter what!

data.name: G2F4_039
data.value: Pokémon are also more willing to join your team if they've been weakened!

data.name: G2F4_040
data.value: Of course,[pause=10] a Pokémon won't always join your team when you t-throw an Apricorn at them...

data.name: G2F4_041
